# OPAIJA Production Plan — 14 Days to Launch-Ready

**Status @ Day 0 (2026-05-12):** Phase = PRE_PRODUCTION. EP001 SCRIPTED, EP002–EP012 narrator scripts now drafted in `data/scripts/` (one file per episode, 158–168 spoken words each, generated by 11 parallel script agents). Character sheets locked (10/10). 0 episodes published. 0 teaser days scheduled. Trailer not started.

**Goal @ Day 14:** EP001 fully rendered, voiced, QA'd, and scheduled. Trailer cut. Teasers TEASER_01–TEASER_07 published. EP002–EP012 scripts polished and locked. EP002–EP004 in active render. All four launch gates from `CLAUDE.md` either green or on a dated path to green.

Strategic posture: **scripts are the bottleneck early, render time is the bottleneck late.** Front-load script QA so voice and video can run in parallel for the back half. Use the Command Center dashboard (`OPAIJA_COMMAND_CENTER_BLUEPRINT.md`) as the single source of truth — every agent updates `QUEUE.json` via the API, never by hand.

## Critical path

The chain that determines launch date: **Script QA (Days 1–2) → Voice profile lock (Day 2) → EP001 assets (Day 3) → EP001 shots submitted (Day 5) → EP001 edit (Day 6) → Canon Guard pass (Day 7) → Trailer (Day 10–11) → Schedule (Day 13) → Go/No-Go (Day 14).** Every other workstream (teasers, EP002+ renders, asset prep for back half) runs as parallel tracks that consume slack but cannot themselves slip the launch.

The single highest-leverage action is **Day 2 voice profile lock** — once the Web-Teller settings are saved, all 12 episode VOs become a parallelizable batch job. Any delay here cascades into every render-edit cycle.

Note: the official launch is gated by **all 12 episodes complete** per `CLAUDE.md`. This 14-day plan delivers EP001–EP005 finished, EP006 in render, scripts locked for all 12, trailer done, and 7/10 teasers shipped. Day 15+ continues the EP006–EP012 render-edit cadence; full launch is roughly Day 21–24 if render throughput holds.

---

## Risks & mitigations

| Risk | Likelihood | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seedance render queue / per-clip latency exceeds estimates | High | Schedule slip | Submit shots in parallel batches; pre-buy capacity; cache approved clips so re-renders only touch failed shots |
| `FAL_KEY` or `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` missing on Day 1 | Medium | Blocks Day 2–3 | Day 1 DevOps audit; everything stays in dry-run mode (per `CLAUDE.md`) until keys land — use the time to refine prompts |
| Canon violation in a generated clip (V-chin, thin lips, modern drumsticks, Marius face shown pre-EP010) | High | Re-render cost | Canon Guard reviews EVERY clip before it enters edit; prompt template enforces the 7 face/hair/drum rules from `OPAIJA_CANON.json`; Marius prompts hard-blocked from face descriptors until EP010 |
| Web-Teller voice drift between batches | Medium | Series feels inconsistent | Lock voice ID + stability/similarity/style in Day 2 profile; never re-tune mid-season; A/B reference clip kept in `public/assets/audio/` |
| Doubles moment missing from a script (canon rule 1) | Medium | Re-script | Canon Guard checklist explicitly tests for `doubles_moment` field on every episode in `QUEUE.json` |
| Asset reuse failing — each episode regenerates backgrounds from scratch | Medium | Render-time bloat | Build a shared asset library in `public/assets/` keyed by location (carnival street, gayelle ground, Mother Lall stall, Papa Etienne home); episodes 1, 7, 8, 12 all reuse the gayelle |
| Trailer leaks Marius face | Low | Canon break, brand damage | Trailer brief explicitly silhouette-only; Canon Guard signs off Day 11 |
| Teaser cadence slips behind episode production | Medium | Weak pre-launch funnel | Teasers are the lowest-effort artifacts (15–30s, often single-shot); never let teaser work block episode work, but never skip a daily teaser slot |
| Single-threaded Director/Canon Guard agent becomes bottleneck | Medium | Wall-clock slip | Define explicit handoff format (JSON status update via API endpoint) so reviews are async, not meeting-based |

## Pre-launch readiness checklist (the 4 gates from `CLAUDE.md`)

- **12 episodes complete** — Day 14 status: 5 done, 1 rendering, 6 scripted + asset-staged. Status: AMBER, on path.
- **30 teaser days scheduled** — Day 14 status: 7 published, 3 in queue, need 20 more. Status: AMBER, requires Days 15–24 teaser sprint.
- **Character sheets locked** — Already 10/10. Status: GREEN.
- **Trailer complete** — Day 11. Status: GREEN by Day 14.

`QUEUE.json` `production_status.cleared_for_launch` flips to `true` only when all four are GREEN. Per `CLAUDE.md`: do not publish EP001 to the public feed until that flag is true — pre-launch teasers only.
